description: This file defines the RomCellRenderer class, which implements custom rendering logic for tree components in a Swing GUI related to Rom objects and TableTreeNodes, including handling display of ROM file information, car info, and various table icons with styling based on selection and access levels.

classes.name: RomCellRenderer
classes.description: Custom tree cell renderer for displaying Rom and TableTreeNode objects in a Swing JTree, with styling based on object properties and selection state.

methods.description: Constructor initializing labels with specific fonts and alignments.
